verdict: clear after lifecycle and subtitle snapshot corrections
checks: Actual bundled reflected members are proven, including obfuscated Guava-returning methods; no replacement library added.
Actual Exo application Looper owns track query/selection and listener cleanup; main thread owns overlay/menu.
Background marker works before a session exists; paused state5 never reactivates a background session.
User pause retains its cue; foreground resume/fullscreen rebind snapshots current Exo cue and preserves IJK effective cue.
Generation, identity and queued-cue serial reject detached, seek-cleared and closed session callbacks.
Default Chinese matching rejects negative labels and unsupported image tracks; manual choice/off remains sticky.
Existing IJK listener is chained and restored only if still owned; Exo listener is additive.
No track polling loop, network translation, external file permission, pause/reprepare or playback restart introduced.
limitations: Actual Android player/native caption execution and device layout remain untested.
Selectable text tracks only; burned-in subtitles cannot be switched.
